body:
📦 **Senate `a03609c`** — feat(sculpture): personal works and upfront commissioned creation rewards

Add independent 64-cube works with fixed owners, notes/TODO, free ongoing sculpture and versioned colored-copy import into the shared exhibition. Personal creation costs 10 units. Explicit user commissions instead cost zero and immediately credit 10 tokens through the existing bank Server. Persist commissioning sources, recipient accounts and transaction references before credit; same-source reuse is rejected and uncertain receipts resume idempotently.

Integrate work selection, notes, creation and import previews into the sculpture viewer. Initialize the displayed default work as a saved selection and cache note text during reload. Install the thin scp-sculpture skill for all three agent clients; CLI returns follow-up instructions.

Validation: release publish, doctor, eight focused sculpture checks passed. Live meadow chair creation consumed 10 expiring vouchers, 15 box edits added 6640 voxels for zero extra fees; native viewer selection/save/render/import-preview verified. Commission tests use a clean-room bank probe and verify rejection and unknown-receipt recovery without live reward issuance.

Fixes TASK-0461
Refs TASK-0460

👥 參與者：@meadow
